scope: All 103 live v019 Latin Russian-shaped prinadlež- membership forms, reviewed against 51 already-canonical prinalež- forms.
choice: Normalize the entire mathematical membership/belonging family to official prinalež-. Preserve every suffix and inflection except ten malformed third-person plural prinadležat forms, which become the grammar-correct prinaležet.
motivation: The inserted d is not part of the official Interslavic lemma and creates an accidental doublet inside single sentences. All sites mean belonging, membership, or pertaining in mathematical classifications; none denotes a separate ownership sense. The edition already contained 51 correct prinalež- forms.
alternatives_rejected: Retain prinadlež- as a regional variant: it is the Russian/Serbo-Croatian comparator shape, not the official bridge lemma, and duplicates established prinalež- in this edition.
Change only the prefix spelling while retaining prinaležat: official second-conjugation third-person plural is prinaležet.
Recast every site with membership nouns or set notation: this would be invasive and unnecessary because official prinaležati exactly expresses the audited meaning.
